# #030 — One Project Wins the Capacity Race
zg361cp.30 = {
	type = character_event
	theme = stewardship
	title = zg361cp.30.t
	desc = zg361cp.30.desc
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_e_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_e_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_e_cycle
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_e_case
		this = scope:zg361_cp_e_owner
		zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
		scope:zg361_cp_e_subject = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_e_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_e_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_e_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_e_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_e_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_e_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_e_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_e_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_e_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_e_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361cp.30.a

		trigger = {
			scope:zg361_cp_e_subject = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred }
					OR = {
						var:zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred = 0
						AND = {
							has_variable = zg361_cp_player_batch_mode
							var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode = 3
						}
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		scope:zg361_cp_e_subject = {
			zg361_cp_m30_route_a_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_e_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_e_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_e_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_e_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:zg361_cp_e_subject = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_runtime_applied }
						var:zg361_cp_runtime_applied = 1
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
			}
			trigger_event = { id = zg361cp.26 days = 1 }
		}
	}
	option = {

		trigger = {

	}
